description: List Morpho vaults (V1 and V2) with net APY, total assets and liquidity in USD, curators, warnings, and `version`. Filter by `chain_ids`, `search`, and other supported fields. Paginate by passing back `cursor` until it is null.

assets.description: Underlying asset selectors, `<chain_id>:<address>` — the same values the `assets` facet returns.

chain_ids.description: Chains to list. Defaults to every chain the app exposes.

collateral_exclusion.description: Collateral asset selectors, `<chain_id>:<address>`. Drops vaults allocating to any of these collaterals; applies to every facet count.

collateral_exposure.description: Collateral asset selectors, `<chain_id>:<address>` — the same values the `collateral_exposure` facet returns. Keeps only vaults allocating to any of these collaterals.

curator_ids.description: Curator ids to list, matched case-insensitively (lowercased before matching and cursor binding).

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

include_facets.description: Return the `facets` extra. Facets are only computed when true; the flag is not part of the cursor binding.

limit.description: Page size. Defaults to 100, at most 1000.

liquidity_usd_gte.description: Minimum `liquidity_usd`. Vaults with a null `liquidity_usd` are left out.

liquidity_usd_lte.description: Maximum `liquidity_usd`. Vaults with a null `liquidity_usd` are left out.

net_apy_gte.description: Minimum `net_apy`, as a decimal rate. Bounds the net APY (native net of fees plus rewards).

net_apy_lte.description: Maximum `net_apy`, as a decimal rate. Bounds the net APY (native net of fees plus rewards).

search.description: Case-insensitive substring of the vault name or address, the asset symbol or address, or a curator name.

sort_by.description: Sort key. Rows with a null sort value come last, except `performance_fee` and `management_fee`, where a null fee sorts as 0 (V1 vaults have no management fee).

total_assets_usd_gte.description: Minimum `total_assets_usd`. Vaults with a null `total_assets_usd` are left out.

total_assets_usd_lte.description: Maximum `total_assets_usd`. Vaults with a null `total_assets_usd` are left out.

versions.description: Vault versions to list. Defaults to every version.

name: morpho_query_vaults

count_total.description: Vaults matching the filters, across every page. Vaults that fail to load are left out and not counted.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Null on the last page.

apy.description: Native: the V2 vault's gross APY before fees, excluding rewards. Null for V1 vaults.

apy_breakdown.description: Native APY split into organic and surplus-boost (donation) parts, gross and net of fees. All fields come from one realtime accrual snapshot (fees included) and reconcile with each other; consumers should take the headline from this object rather than mix it with the top-level apy / net_apy_excluding_rewards, which come from a separate realtime read. Null when the vault has no accrual checkpoint or the breakdown read fails.

apy.description: Native: gross APY of this snapshot; equals organic_apy + surplus_boost_apy. Decimal, 0.05 = 5%. An infinite value is clamped to the largest finite number.

net_apy_excluding_rewards.description: Net: apy after this snapshot's performance and management fees, excluding rewards. Decimal. Null when the value is not a number; an infinite value is clamped to the largest finite number.

organic_apy.description: Native: what apy would be without the surplus, capped by the vault's maxRate. Decimal. An infinite value is clamped to the largest finite number.

organic_net_apy_excluding_rewards.description: Net: organic_apy after the same fees. Decimal. Null when the value is not a number; an infinite value is clamped to the largest finite number.

surplus_boost_active.description: Native: whether apy is pinned to the maxRate APY by the surplus.

surplus_boost_apy.description: Native: APY points added by the surplus (donations), only the part under the maxRate cap. Decimal. An infinite value is clamped to the largest finite number.

surplus_boost_net_apy_excluding_rewards.description: Net: net_apy_excluding_rewards minus organic_net_apy_excluding_rewards, floored at 0; null when either is null. Decimal. An infinite value is clamped to the largest finite number.

logo_uri.description: Null when no logo is known.

name.description: Null when the token has no name.

price_usd.description: USD price of one token. Null when no price is known.

yield_apr.description: Native yield of the asset itself (e.g. staking), a fraction. Not part of any vault APY. Read with the vault snapshot, so it can lag the `yield.apr` that `/tokens` serves by the snapshot TTL. Null when the asset has no known yield or the yield read failed.

yield_apy.description: Native yield of the asset itself (e.g. staking), as an APY fraction. Not part of any vault APY. Read with the vault snapshot, so it can lag the `yield.apy` that `/tokens` serves by the snapshot TTL. Null when the asset has no known yield or the yield read failed.

aum_usd.description: Assets under management across vaults, in USD.

image.description: Null when the curator has no image.

exposure_usd.description: USD value allocated to this collateral. Null when the asset has no USD price, never 0.

liquidity_usd.description: `liquidity` in USD. Null when the asset has no USD price, never 0.

management_fee.description: Annualised management fee, as a decimal fraction. Null for V1 vaults, which have no management fee.

max_rate.description: Native: the V2 rate cap on the realised APY. Null for V1 vaults.

net_apy.description: Net: native APY net of fees plus rewards-only APRs.

net_apy_excluding_rewards.description: Native: net of fees, excluding rewards.

performance_fee.description: Performance fee, as a decimal fraction.

rewards.description: The composed vault-level reward set. Allocation-level market rewards are already included in it and must never be added on top.

supply_apr.description: Rewards-only: the APR this reward adds, as a decimal rate, excluding the native APY.

total_assets_usd.description: `total_assets` in USD. Null when the asset has no USD price, never 0.

warnings.description: The vault's own warnings only. GREEN warnings are never returned.

content.description: Custom warning text. Null for every non-custom warning type.

delisted.description: True on a `not_whitelisted` warning when the vault has a listing history, i.e. it was listed before and delisted; vvrm shows it as deprecated. False otherwise.

logo_uri.description: Null when no logo is known.

tags.description: Null when no tags are known for the token.

metadata.description: Null when no metadata is known for the asset.

total_assets_usd.description: Sum over the chain's listed vaults regardless of filters; vaults without a USD value add 0.

logo_uri.description: Null when no logo is known.

tags.description: Null when no tags are known for the token.

metadata.description: Null when no metadata is known for the asset.
Null when no metadata is known for the curator.

facets.description: Null unless `include_facets` is true. Each facet counts the vaults matching every other filter, ignoring its own; `collateral_exclusion` applies to all of them.
